system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Storage bucket for hosting a static website.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud Storage bucket for hosting a static website.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
  - name: static-website-bucket
    type: storage.v1.bucket
    properties:
      bucketName: static-website-bucket
      storageClass: STANDARD
      location: US
      versioning:
        enabled: true
      website:
        mainPageSuffix: index.html
        NotFoundPage: 404.html
      cors:
        - method: ['GET', 'HEAD']
          origin: ['*']
          responseHeader: ['Content-Type']
          maxAgeSeconds: 3600
      iamPolicy:
        bindings:
          - role: roles/storage.objectViewer
            members:
              - allUsers
          - role: roles/storage.legacyObjectReader
            members:
              - allUsers
      lifecycle:
        rule:
          - action:
              type: Delete
            condition:
              age: 365
              isLive: false
          - action:
              type: SetStorageClass
            condition:
              age: 30
              matchesStorageClass: STANDARD
            storageClass: NEARLINE
          - action:
              type: SetStorageClass
            condition:
              age: 365
              matchesStorageClass: NEARLINE
            storageClass: COLDLINE
          - action:
              type: SetStorageClass
            condition:
              age: 730
              matchesStorageClass: COLDLINE
            storageClass: ARCHIVE
outputs:
  - name: bucketName
    value: $(ref.static-website-bucket.name)
